padre.aspetto: a gaunt man in his fifties with dark messy hair, bulging eyes and crooked teeth, in a worn denim jacket over a grey t-shirt

parti.occhi: His eyes are glassy and bloodshot with fever, the rims red and watery, a sheen of sweat on the skin.
parti.bocca: Crooked, rotten yellow-brown teeth and cracked lips; nothing else unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the left side of his neck under the jaw, with the collar of the denim jacket pulled aside
collo.segni: Under the jaw there is a hard, swollen lump the size of an egg, dark reddish purple and shiny, stretching the skin: a plague bubo.

parti.mani: Big rough mechanic's hands stained with black engine grease: grease in the creases of the skin and under the nails, smudges on the fingertips; under the grease the skin is healthy.

figlia.aspetto: a thin young woman in her twenties with long dark hair, bulging frightened eyes and hollow cheeks, in a purple hoodie

parti.occhi: Tired, frightened eyes with dark circles from lack of sleep; the whites are clear, not red, no fever.
parti.bocca: Dry, chapped lips; healthy gums and teeth.
parti.collo: A thin neck with prominent tendons and the edge of the purple hoodie; pale but healthy skin, no swelling.
parti.mani: Thin hands with the nails bitten down to the skin and a few small cuts around them; otherwise healthy.
